notes.evidence: Source inspection at the pinned revisions; no full inference observation claimed.
notes.serialization: Python list of dictionaries; scores and boxes are torch tensors, labels is a list of strings
notes.representation: Structure describes the tensor-to-list projection for schema validation, not a JSON exporter supplied by the model.
notes.scope: Version-specific Hugging Face workflow matching the author model card box_threshold/text_threshold example. Later Transformers releases may change keys and signatures. Excludes raw model logits and the separate original GroundingDINO repository API.
notes.coordinates: boxes is N x 4 in [x1,y1,x2,y2] order. With target_sizes=[(height,width)] as in the model card, coordinates are original-image pixels; without target_sizes they are normalized. No clipping is done in this postprocessor.
notes.confidence: scores is the maximum sigmoid token-alignment score per retained query, strictly greater than box_threshold. labels contains decoded prompt phrases selected using text_threshold, not numeric category IDs.
notes.batch: One dictionary per image; scores, labels and boxes have equal length. Empty results have zero rows in all three fields. Image identities, dimensions and prompt are not included.
